snippet.title: Ryder Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Ryder is an upcoming creature-collecting puzzle game! 

Play as more than 60 unique creatures.
Solve 100 intricate puzzles across four colorful regions.
Restore creatures to a beautifully crafted low-poly world and ascend the mystical Sanguine Mountain. 

Join us on this epic journey to fulfill your destiny as a Ryder!

Don't forget to wishlist on Steam and stay tuned for more updates!

Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3283790/Ryder/
